title: Places of the city and beyond
summary: The city and its five districts, the Colosseum, the Endless Tower, the training grounds and the seasonal islands.

blocks.text: Everything starts in the city , rebuilt after Seoul in the New City update: a safe plaza with the Registry, the forge, the market, the guild hall and the gemstone stands, and quarters grouped in four danger zones where rifts open. The further from the Docks, the more dangerous. 25 transit kiosks link every place.
